import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
# Constants for configuration
RANGE = 100
SIZE = 1000
CLUSTERS = 5
def task_func():
    # Generate 2D random points in the range [0, RANGE)
    data_points = np.random.randint(0, RANGE, size=(SIZE, 2))

    # Fit KMeans clustering model
    kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=CLUSTERS, random_state=42, n_init=10)
    labels = kmeans.fit_predict(data_points)

    # Plot clustered points and centroids
    plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
    cmap = plt.cm.get_cmap("tab10", CLUSTERS)

    for cluster_id in range(CLUSTERS):
        cluster_points = data_points[labels == cluster_id]
        plt.scatter(
            cluster_points[:, 0],
            cluster_points[:, 1],
            s=20,
            color=cmap(cluster_id),
            label=f"Cluster {cluster_id + 1}",
            alpha=0.7,
        )

    plt.scatter(
        kmeans.cluster_centers_[:, 0],
        kmeans.cluster_centers_[:, 1],
        s=200,
        c="black",
        marker="X",
        label="Centroids",
    )

    plt.title("KMeans Clustering of Random 2D Points")
    plt.xlabel("X")
    plt.ylabel("Y")
    plt.legend()
    plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

    return data_points, kmeans
